title: refresh-manifest v1
description: Arms one component refresh after a merge. A merge is not a deployment: this manifest is what the repo and image watchers emit, what the outside-in refresh consumes, and what the live gate (G2) verifies by read-back.

merge-sha.description: The merged commit being deployed. The live gate reads the target back against this sha, fail-closed.

target.description: Exactly one component per manifest; the stagger is one manifest per side, refreshed from outside.

image.description: The merged image reference. Required when target is dev-container.

kind.description: image: roll back to this image. converger: re-converge from this repository version.

rollback.description: The previous known-good state. Every autonomous mutation is reversible (P10); a manifest without a rollback is refused.

session-policy.description: resume: capture the session set, refresh, restore every session to active work, verified (the standing rule). defer: live sessions block until they quit (the fallback for unproven resume classes, never the steady state).

kind.description: file-sha: a deployed file's digest. command: a read-back command's output. service-state: a unit/container's live state.

expect.description: The exact expected value the live gate compares against.

verify.description: The read-back checks G2 runs on the live target. Not done until every check passes.

armed-by.description: The watcher that armed the refresh (repo clock or image clock).
